message.amendments.ebe_warning: [Amendments] Enhanced Block Entities is installed. Signs will render wrong and hanging signs won't swivel until you turn off those in EBE's own config.
amendments.configuration.lectern.improve: Improved lectern screen allowing to edit font of a book while on it
amendments.configuration.fireball.thrown: Cooldown for fire & dragon charges in ticks
amendments.configuration.fireball.gravit: Makes fire & dragon charges have gravity
amendments.configuration.fireball.deflec: Makes fire charges deflectable by punching
amendments.configuration.fireball.fire_c: Makes dispensers shoot fire charges (the ones with gravity added by the mod) instead of blaze charges. Technically a breaking changes as it could break existing contraptions while allowing for new ones
amendments.configuration.fireball.improv: Improves ghast & fire charges fireballs by giving them a unique explosion particles and set on fire on hit
amendments.configuration.snowball.freeze: Allows snowballs to freeze entities on hit. Config is for how many ticks it will freeze
amendments.configuration.hanging_signs.i: Allows placing items on hanging signs
amendments.configuration.cauldron.hand_c: Allows crafting items using cauldrons by clicking on them
amendments.configuration.cauldron.in_wor: Allows crafting items using cauldrons by throwing items in them
amendments.configuration.cauldron.dye_wa: Allows dying cauldron water bedrock style and mixing them too
amendments.configuration.cauldron.dye_re: Max amount of items that 1 cauldron layer can recolor.This is a multiplier on top of vanilla crafting recipe amount
amendments.configuration.cauldron.potion: Max amount of items that 1 cauldron layer can craft with potions.This is a multiplier on top of vanilla crafting recipe amount
Max amount of effects allowed in a mixed potion
amendments.configuration.cauldron.invers: Map of potion ids to their inverse ids. Used for potion mixing
amendments.configuration.cauldron.consis: Makes it so a dripstone drop only increments a cauldron by 1 layer(buttle) instead of a full bottle, making it just like a water cauldron
amendments.configuration.tripwire_hook.t: Allows placing tools on tripwire hooks
amendments.configuration.carpets.carpete: Allows you to place carpets on stairs
Allows you to place carpets on slabs
amendments.configuration.cake.double_cak: Allows you to place a cake on top of another
amendments.configuration.cake.directiona: Allows eating a cake from every side
amendments.configuration.mob_head.skull_: Allows you to place two mob heads on top of each other
Allows candles to be placed on top of skulls
amendments.configuration.mob_head.multip: Allows placing more than one candle ontop of each skull
amendments.configuration.flower_pot.hang: allows you to place hanging flower pots. Works with any modded pot too
amendments.configuration.lantern.high_pr: Gives high priority to wall lantern placement. Enable to override other wall lanterns placements, disable if it causes issues with other mods that use lower priority block click events
amendments.configuration.lantern.falling: Allows ceiling lanterns to fall if their support is broken.Additionally if they fall from high enough they will break creating a fire where they land
amendments.configuration.bell.chain_ring: Ring a bell by clicking on a chain that's connected to it
amendments.configuration.bell.chain_leng: Max chain length that allows a bell to ring
amendments.configuration.banners.ceiling: Allow banners to be placed on ceilings
amendments.configuration.misc.dye_blocks: Allows dying blocks by right clicking them with dye
amendments.configuration.misc.passenger_: Prevents entities from taking suffocation damage while riding another entity
amendments.configuration.torch.torch_fir: Allows torches to set entities on fire
Allows torches to set entities on fire when held in offhand given you are attacking with a sword
Duration of the on fire effect applied by torches. In seconds
amendments.configuration.lily_pad.better: Allows lilypads to have any block placed ontop
amendments.configuration.general.texture: Makes dynamically generated assets depend on texture packs too and not just vanilla files
amendments.configuration.general.no_enha: Disables the chat warning shown when Enhanced Block Entities is installed
amendments.configuration.sign.pixel_cons: Gives signs a pixel consistent model and texture. Also affects other mods. This also makes them use a Block Model, making them render much much much faster than as block entities
amendments.configuration.sign.text_color: A scalar multiplier that will be applied to sign text making it brighter, supposedly more legible
amendments.configuration.sign.sign_black: A list of sign blocks that will NOT be affected by the pixel consistent sign setting. Use full registry names separated by commas
amendments.configuration.projectiles.fir: Makes ghast & blazes fireballs render in 3D
amendments.configuration.projectiles.gha: Makes ghast & blazes fireballs leave a trail of particles when moving
amendments.configuration.projectiles.dra: Makes dragon fireballs leave a trail of particles when moving
amendments.configuration.projectiles.cha: Makes 3D charges tumble in the air when moving
amendments.configuration.projectiles.pro: Makes 3D snowballs and slimeballs (supp compat) tumble in the air when moving
amendments.configuration.dragon_fireball: Makes dragon's breath particles emissive to better match new visuals
amendments.configuration.lily_pad.y_offs: set to 0 tho have lilypads at the same exact position as vanilla.negative numbers will place them in their own blockspace right below avoiding any clipping.best of both worlds at default as its barely within its space
amendments.configuration.bell.chain_atta: Visually attach chains and ropes to bells
amendments.configuration.brewing_stand.b:
Colors the brewing stand potion texture depending on the potions it's brewing.
If using a resource pack add tint index from 0 to 3 to the 3 potion layers
amendments.configuration.arrows.crossbow: Makes tipped arrows show their colors when loaded with a crossbow
amendments.configuration.tripwire_hook.f: Makes hooks render faster using a block model instead of tile renderer. Cost is that animated and enchanted items will appear static
amendments.configuration.hanging_sign.it: Scale of items on hanging signs (unit is in pixel they would occupy). Set to 8 to better match the pixels on the sign
amendments.configuration.hanging_sign.si: Signs have visual attachment to walls and fences
amendments.configuration.lantern.fast_la: Makes wall lantern use a simple block model instead of the animated tile entity renderer. This will make them render much faster but will also remove the animationNote that this option only affect lanterns close by as the one far away render as fast by default
amendments.configuration.lantern.entity_: Renders the swaying wall lantern through the item renderer so its shading comes from the model's normals instead of the block model's baked per-face shading. This makes the lantern shade correctly no matter which wall it faces, at the cost of losing block ambient occlusion. Only affects the animated (close-up) renderer
amendments.configuration.lantern.lantern: Size lanterns when held in hand
Gives a special animation to lanterns when held in hand
Makes lantern holding animation have the arm angled more upwards. Looks better if you have dynamic lights on
amendments.configuration.cauldron.potion: Gives a unique texture to potion cauldrons
amendments.configuration.jukebox.disc_sp: Makes jukebox disc spin while playing
amendments.configuration.misc.torch_item: Gives a special animation to torches when held in hand
Size lanterns when held in hand
Renders a flame particle on top of held torches
amendments.configuration.misc.candle_hol: Gives a special animation to supplementaries candle holders when held in hand
amendments.configuration.misc.handle_hol: Size lanterns when held in hand
amendments.configuration.misc.fixed_hold: Makes Torch and Lantern holding animation be fixed, not changing with player facing
amendments.configuration.misc.campfire_s: Prevents campfire smoke from rendering if there is a solid block above it
